description_en: Support structured detection of multi-subject teaching aid test papers, automatically splitting questions from entire pages of workbooks, test papers, or teaching aids, and detecting the text content and coordinate positions within them
description_zh: 支持多学科教辅试卷的结构化识别，将整页练习册、试卷或教辅中的题目进行自动切题，并识别出其中的文字内容和坐标位置
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-edu-paper-structed --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241223/sqecwj/%E7%B2%BE%E7%BB%86%E7%89%88%E7%BB%93%E6%9E%84%E5%8C%96%E5%88%87%E9%A2%98.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --subject 'default:默认,_Math:数学,_PrimarySchool_Math:小学数学,_JHighSchool_Math:_初中数学,_Chinese:语文,_PrimarySchool_Chinese:小学语文,_JHighSchool_Chinese:初中语文,_English:英语,_PrimarySchool_English:小学英语,_JHighSchool_English:初中英语,_Physics:物理,_JHighSchool_Physics:初中物理,_Chemistry:_化学,_JHighSchool_Chemistry:初中化学,_Biology:生物,_JHighSchool_Biology:初中生物,_History:历史,_JHighSchool_History:初中历史,_Geography:地理,_JHighSchool_Geography:初中地理,_Politics:政治,_JHighSchool_Politics:初中政治' --need-rotate false --output-oricoord false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEduPaperStructed

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass both or leave both empty.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 encoding is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass both or leave both empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation. By default, this feature is disabled.  
true: Enable; false: Disable.

是否需要自动旋转功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output original image coordinate information (for example, if the image has undergone rotation or correction). By default, this feature is disabled.  
If you need original coordinates, we recommend setting the NeedRotate parameter to true.  
true: Enable; false: Disable.
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出原图坐标信息（如果图片被做过旋转，图片校正等处理），默认不需要。
如需输出原图坐标，建议同时将NeedRotate参数设置为true。
true：需要；false：不需要
